info.title: TileSim Local Bridge API
info.description: Loopback-only controlled execution and evidence API for the desktop TileSim web client.

200.description: One streamed conversation turn: prose events while the answer is written, then one plan event
One streamed, read-only result analysis: prose events while the answer is written, then done

messages.description: The transcript the client already shows, oldest first, ending with the user's turn. Only the user and assistant roles are accepted.

panel_values.description: The current panel values, keyed by bare parameter name. Read-only context for the model; never executed or written.

messages.description: The client-side transcript, ending with the user's result question.

answer_state.description: settings: a settings block was read. prose_only: the model answered in prose and proposed nothing. settings_unparsed: a settings block was present but could not be read, so no value is proposed.

structured_inputs.description: Optional complete synthetic runtime_trace and topology proposal. The page validates and applies it atomically; it never creates a run.

models.description: The model identities the configured service publishes, in the order it published them and without duplicates. Read with the credential the channel already holds; the credential is never part of this response.

selected_model.description: The identity the next request will use: a panel selection when one is in force for this process, otherwise the configured identity.

session_override.description: True when selected_model came from a panel selection for this process rather than from the saved configuration.

in_force.description: True, always: the identity is the one this Bridge process uses from the next request on.

persisted.description: False, always: this endpoint never writes the saved configuration, which stays owned by the launcher.

session_only.description: True, always: the selection lasts until this Bridge process is restarted.

TracePackageCatalog.description: Controlled Trace-package catalog without local filesystem paths

AssistantModelDescriptor.description: Optional assistant model channel state; the credential is never included

AssistantModelPlan.description: One validated scenario plan proposal; applying it stays a client-side action

AssistantModelCatalogue.description: The model identities the configured service publishes; read with the channel credential, which never leaves the Bridge

AssistantModelSelection.description: The identity now in force for this Bridge process; nothing was persisted and no run was created

EvidenceAgentDescriptor.description: Read-only evidence Agent capability and degradation contract

EvidenceAgentResponse.description: Run-bound terminal evidence analysis or structured refusal

AgentOrchestrationCapabilitySnapshot.description: Immutable Agent orchestration capability and Profile availability snapshot

AgentOrchestrationRunIntakePreview.description: Read-only Run Intake v2 preview verdict. Returned for every submission the published contract can judge, including rejections; judgement.accepted and judgement.code carry the verdict. The error envelope is used only when no judgement could be produced.

Week7Calibration.description: Allow-listed S8 offline calibration workflow example

DeleteRun.description: Deleted local run and its artifacts
